description: Calculation, not advice. Verify with a professional before acting. Size an emergency fund target based on the borrower's monthly essential expenses, job stability, dependents, and income redundancy. Returns a tier breakdown (minimum, target, conservative; the target row is omitted when it equals the 3-month minimum, and the conservative row is omitted when it equals the 12-month ceiling), the gap between current savings and the target, and time-to-target at the supplied monthly savings cadence. Pick this to size an emergency-fund target; pick `calculate_runway` when savings are already fixed and the question is how many months they will last, not what the target is. Pairs with debt-payoff content for the recurring 'save vs pay debt' question. Target months are clamped to [3, 12]: never below the 3-month personal-finance minimum, never above 12.

chart_title.description: Override for the chart title. Must not contain em-dashes or en-dashes. Max 120 characters. Optional.

current_savings.description: What you have in liquid emergency-accessible savings today. Decimal from 0 to $1,000,000,000. Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

dependents.description: Number of dependents. Integer from 0 to 20. +1 target month per dependent, capped at +3. Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

has_dual_income.description: When true, partner income reduces the buffer by 1 month. Optional; defaults to false when omitted.

job_stability.description: 'stable_w2' | 'variable_income' | 'self_employed' | 'between_jobs'. Drives the target-months multiplier: stable_w2 salaried W-2 with consistent paycheck (+0 months); variable_income W-2 with commission/bonus/shift-based pay (+1 month); self_employed 1099 contractor/freelancer/sole proprietor (+3 months); between_jobs actively job hunting, no current paycheck (+5 months). Optional; defaults to 'stable_w2' when omitted.

monthly_essential_expenses.description: Rent/mortgage + utilities + food + insurance + minimum debt payments. NOT discretionary spending. Decimal from $0.01 to $1,000,000,000. REQUIRED, no default.

monthly_savings_capacity.description: What you can contribute toward the gap each month. Drives months_to_target. Decimal, either 0 or from $0.01 to $1,000,000,000. Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

name: calculate_emergency_fund
title: Emergency Fund Calculator
